text: This document defines the electrical design criteria for the Alpilla 1 x 1 multi-shaft combined cycle power plant (net 600 MW): system voltages and earthing, short-circuit ratings, auxiliary power redundancy, motors, cables, protection, earthing and lightning protection, lighting, hazardous areas, emergency power, and the electrical studies that confirm them. It is the basis for the electrical specifications, calculations, single line diagrams and material requisitions of the project.
